symptom: Any file type could be uploaded by spoofing the Content-Type header; one media route was accessible without authentication
rootcause: Two separate issues: (1) The finalize endpoint only validated the declared MIME type but did not read the actual file bytes to check magic bytes, so a client could upload a malicious file disguised as an image. (2) One media HTTP route was missing the JwtAuthGuard decorator
fix: (1) Added magic byte validation in FinalizeUploadUseCase via the MimeValidatorPort — SharpMimeValidator reads actual file bytes. (2) Applied JwtAuthGuard to the unguarded route
